steps.content: Below a base station outside BR-000, you put on your breathing mask. Blue dust floating by your cheeks goes in and out of the filter as you breathe. The monsters' roars coming in from a distance add to the already tense atmosphere.
After receiving the call for help, you immediately brought a small group of police officers toward the frontline.
Yet you were greeted by dozens of plainly dressed corpses and silent guardsmen.
They were the ones who tried to attack the Broken Frontline.
The leader of the group, wearing an FAC uniform, steps forward to answer your question.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: I'm Cole, the bo... the Captain here. Err, I mean the person in charge. They usually call me Boss.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Those on the ground said that the government had taken away their resources for survival and made life a living hell for them. They were convinced that the government's resources are kept under the shield of the base station.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: They said... they're here to take back what belongs to them.
It is true that there have been rumors like this.
But I don't think that should be a reason to kill them off.
You frown and look at Cole.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: They said something was installed on the base station that made them unable to sleep, so they attacked us with a bunch of believers or just troublemakers.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: They claimed that we set up the base stations here to prevent civilians from approaching and to evict them.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: They may be dressed up as civilians, but hidden under their clothes are knives and guns.

options: Explain why you're here and the rules

choices.text: Explain why you're here and the rules

steps.content: I'm the Chief of MBCC. I was asked to support when I received news that the M values here were rising and there were possible attacks of Corruptors or Sinners.
To avoid Mania to spread any further, you should've dealt with them only after I determined whether their M-value has reached the critical point.
Besides, even dead bodies might spread Mania contamination.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: You are... the chief of MBCC?
Cole touched the Hypercube pyramid before his chest, and took a few glances at you.
Yes.
You ask the FAC officers to maintain order with the frontline personnel and begin looking at the bodies for possible infections.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Chief, the force field shield from the base station shows signs of being attacked.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: But it doesn't seem like mania weapons were used.

Hearing this, you leave the body you're checking and start to survey the Broken Frontline's base station shields. They seem more likely to be worn by the blades and guns of Syndicate's gangsters and Outlanders.
Weird...
The Broken Frontline is the weakest protection for BR-000. The distressing atmosphere of DisSea is almost breaking through the shields and drowning all of you, nauseating and anguishing.
Ordinary people will not come to a place like this for such reasons. And these marks and the wounds on the corpses are clearly from the same weapons.
The wounds on the corpses were not caused by an FAC weapon. You are not...

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: You're kinda smart, huh?
The moment you turn around, the barrel of a cold gun is pressed against your forehead. The men you brought are already under their control without making a sound.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: From what I've heard from these corpses, the base stations are managed by some MC thing, and you happen to be the chief.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Be a good kid and open this thing up.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Or else... you'll become a part of that pile.
The base stations keep death and contamination away! There's nothing that you want inside!
Opening it up will only make your infection worse!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: So... you're not gonna cooperate?

Cole signals his men with his eyes. Since your arrival, those men have been hanging around your officers. Once they receive the cue, they skillfully stab into the fragile gaps of the protective suits, killing all your officers.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Ahhhhhhh—!
The metallic smell of blood rushed in all of a sudden. As if felt the smell, DisSea rose a wave of fear and suppression that filled the air in a second. It is suffocating.
You!
Before you can say anything, your lost balance and felt dizzy. Your palms and knees are grazed by the gravel. Cole slammed you hard on the ground, looking down at you while stepping on the rubble.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Tough, eh? Let's see how long you can last.
Cole turned around and fired several shots in quick succession at the Broken Frontline.
Stop it!
The bullet pierced Cole's palm but you saw no blood. Instead, a thick, reeking liquid came out...
You've become a Maniac!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Ah... having wandered in DisSea for so long, how could I possibly not gain the devil's favor?

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: But I am very fond of this power...

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Are you afraid, Chief of the MBCC?
This power is beyond your control and you will only end up being infected further until finally being corrupted by it.
Cole kicked the gun out of your hand. With a single swing, he slammed you onto the shield.
Despite the pain, you drew out your gun, ran toward Cole, and pressed it against his chest.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Ha... The chief from MBCC has some guts. I'll give you that.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: But unfortunately, you won't be able to kill me now.
Cole gave a sinister expression and thrust himself toward you.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Come on, shoot me. Oh, that's right... You, Chief, just said we need your approval before killing anyone, no matter who it is.
You look at the twisted face of Cole. The black liquid splashed on his protective suit. The Hypercube pyramid on it is quickly turning red and getting smaller. He is beyond saving.
Cole took advantage of your hesitation and brutally slammed your head against the base station.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: It doesn't matter if you don't cooperate. We were planning on taking this step anyway.
The sharp pain from your scalp extended to your tailbone. Cole tossed you to the ground by your hair.

He ordered his men to take up guns or even small artillery and begin bombarding the Broken Frontline. The cracks in the shield got bigger and made a crunching sound. The force field covering DisSea is starting to weaken.
Stop!!!

Your wounds are giving you tearing pain, but they're the least of your problems. You press the communicator, requesting immediate support from HQ. In the meantime, you grab a weapon from one of the corpses, giving Cole a flurry of attacks.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Hah! That doesn't even tickle!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Are you really the chief or something? How about you let me take your place!
Cole took on your attacks and got close to you quickly, putting one hand around your neck. He picked you up and crushed you against a nearby abandoned statue.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Hahaha...hahaha!!! Do you feel my power!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Why not save your strength? Once we make a hole in it, I need you to lead the way... Or I guess I could just kill you right now.
Being strangled, the air in your throat is escaping, and your vision starts to get blurry.
A flash of bright color walked into your sight, when you thought you were about to die from strangulation on this abandoned statue.
Look who's deep in prison, trapped in the tower...
My poor little monster, fear no more...

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: A woman?
Cole looked up at the woman standing on the statue, but her hood covered her eyes so he couldn't see clearly.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: That's your backup? Just this woman?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It's just some howling animals...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I am more than enough.

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: How dare you...
Before Cole could finish, several black light balls exploded in his face, causing him to let go of his hands.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Hmph, get a taste of the other side.
A tarot card flew out of her hand into the shield that they have been frantically bombarding.

The card seemed to freeze the cracked base station for a while, and many shield pieces were shaken off from it. Through those little gaps, everyone saw the dark and crimson interlaced with little blue lights, like the pastel blue sapphire.

steps.speaker: Smuggler
steps.content: Boss! Hypercubes... it's Hypercubes!!!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Hahahah! I knew it! There are a great many Hypercubes stored inside!
Seeing the blue color, Cole's eyes turned red. He didn't seem to care about the blood flowing from his head at all and crazily rushed toward the gaps.
No... *cough, you can't. You're already...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Where are you going, my little monster?
The woman standing on the high ground leaps down and grabs onto you to look at the surge of people and black smoke on the other side of the station.
They are like bloodthirsty leeches that are greedily sucking in the slightest bit of scent coming from DisSea.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The smell of Hypercubes, the smell of death, the smell of money...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: To these outlaws, money outweighs life.
I know... that they are Hypercube smugglers from Outland.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Oh? You knew already, my little monster?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: But it seems like they won't last long.
No, *cough... We can't let them open the shield!
The Hypercubes in Syndicate are all contaminated by Mania! If they live on them, they must have long been infected!
We knew that there has always been a group of ghost-like smugglers in DisSea... Never thought I would meet them here...
Their M values have passed the critical point. If they get any closer... they'll turn into Corruptors!

steps.speaker: Cole
steps.content: Piss off! I'll do it myself, you trash! Hahahahah!
Losing his mind, Cole pushed his man viciously away.
The abandoned statue behind him is covered with sharp debris, but Cole did not care at all about falling on it. All he could think about are Hypercubes.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: They deceived you and you still want to save them?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: They are greedy and cunning... donning themselves in sheep's skin to deceive the innocent.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: They are cruel and ignorant... digging their own graves.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You destroyed people like them when you were at WhiteSands. Why do you want to help them and even... save them now?
That's not helping them.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The tower has been erected. No one can escape the punishment of the world. People like them will not be able to live until the end.
But in the face of a catastrophe, everyone is equal.
If the station is destroyed, the crisis in DisSea will escalate! Many more will die!
I can't possibly...!
What are you doing?!

Stargazer lifted you by your collar and pinned you against the statue. You were startled and instinctively tried to use the shackles. DisSea was surging, as if it's waiting for you to release the shackles in excitement.
The fluctuations of the shackles hummed in the depths of your mind, calling you to be alert to DisSea's temptations, and to... the person in front of you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: My divination, my prophecy...  will not be so easily broken.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The outcomes are inevitable, Chief. There's nothing you can do to change them.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Of course... you can choose to bind me with your shackles and take the helm of your own destiny.
